warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Heights are measured from ระดับพื้นห้อง: every door is 2.05; windows print sill + window height against the head.
น3 prints sill 0.85 + window 1.10 against an overall 2.05 (adds to 1.95) — kept the printed values, flagged (same drafting pattern as house 95's น3/น4).
